outputs.explanation: Panel A shows bright-field and fluorescence images of lungs; it is not a quantitative plot.
Panel B is a bar chart of mean ICG fluorescence intensity with SD error bars, and individual data points (blue and red dots for each mouse) are overlaid on the bars.

Panel C shows histology, fluorescence, RNAscope images and spatial transcriptomics heatmap-style plots (Cd68, Spp1 expression overlaid on tissue), not a summary bar/line plot requiring individual points.
Panel D consists of GSEA enrichment line plots, which are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement since overlaying points on a line plot would make it unreadable.

Panel E is a bar graph of log2 fold-change values derived from differential gene expression testing (Wilcoxon rank-sum across thousands of spatial spots) rather than a mean of a small number of biological replicates; the underlying spot-level data are not practically displayable as individual points on this plot.
Panel F shows fluorescence and IHC images, not a quantitative plot.
